Reach for this skill when building skills for agents, evaluating skill quality, improving skill descriptions, or adding skills support to an agent product. metadata: mintlify-proj: agent version: "1.0" --- # Agent Skills Agent Skills is an open format for packaging specialized instructions, scripts, and resources that agents can discover and use to perform tasks more accurately. A skill is a folder containing a `SKILL.md` file (metadata + instructions), optional `scripts/`, `references/`, and `assets/` directories, and supporting files. ## Product summary
